## Today's Agenda: Demos! And More Demos! {.title-13}

* Spark `DataFrame`s
* [`MLlib`](https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/ml-guide.html): **Official** Spark library!
* [SparkNLP](https://sparknlp.org/): 3rd-Party Library

## Spark `DataFrame` {.smaller .text-65 .crunch-title .crunch-p .crunch-ul data-name="Spark DataFrame"}

...Yet another type of `DataFrame`!

:::: {layout="[[1,1],[1]]"}
::: {#df-pandas}

<i class='bi bi-1-circle' style='font-size: 90%;'></i> **Pandas**

* Everything in RAM
* All computations **eager**ly executed

``` {.python}
data_df['price'].mean()
```

:::
::: {#df-polars}

<i class='bi bi-2-circle' style='font-size: 90%;'></i> **Polars**: Introduced **lazy** execution

* $\leadsto$ separation of *computation* from *data*
* Optimized for *multicore* computation

``` {.python}
ratio_expr = (
  pl.col('work_hrs') / pl.col('sleep_hrs')
).alias('sleep_ratio')
data_pl.with_columns(ratio_expr).collect()
```

:::
::: {#df-pyspark}

<i class='bi bi-3-circle' style='font-size: 90%;'></i> **PySpark**

``` {.python}
data_sdf = spark.createDataFrame([
    [1, 2.0, 's1', date(2000, 1, 1), datetime(2000, 1, 1, 12, 0)],
    [2, 3.0, 's2', date(2000, 3, 1), datetime(2000, 1, 3, 12, 0)],
], schema='a long, b double, c string, d date, e timestamp')
data_sdf
```

* Optimized for *distributed* computation $\leadsto$ requires an <i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle"></i> **always-running process** <i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle"></i>
* Wrapper around `RDD` (**R**esilient **D**istributed **D**ataset): `data_sdf.rdd.getNumPartitions()`

:::
::::

## First Things First: OpenJDK

* **Spark 4**: Recommended JDK version = [**21**](https://openjdk.org/projects/jdk/21/)
  * *(How would you know without me telling you? Truly idk)*

  ``` {.bash}
  sudo apt install openjdk-21-jdk-headless
  ```
* Install this <i class='bi bi-1-circle' style='font-size: 80%;'></i> on the **master** node and <i class='bi bi-2-circle' style='font-size: 80%;'></i> on **all worker nodes** that you'd like to link together
  * *(Run `sudo apt update` first if on a new instance!)*

## Getting + Using Spark

<center style="margin-top: 40px;">

[[**Apache Spark Downloads Page**](https://spark.apache.org/downloads.html){.external}]{.boxed-cb}

</center>

* <i class='bi bi-1-circle'></i> **Click through** the ["Download Spark" link](https://www.apache.org/dyn/closer.lua/spark/spark-4.2.0/spark-4.2.0-bin-hadoop3-connect.tgz)...
* <i class='bi bi-2-circle'></i> ...To get the actual [**download URL**](https://dlcdn.apache.org/spark/spark-4.2.0/spark-4.2.0-bin-hadoop3-connect.tgz) 😵‍💫
* <i class='bi bi-3-circle'></i> Use `wget <url>` in terminal to download `.tar.gz`:

  ``` {.bash style="font-size: 80%;"}
  wget https://dlcdn.apache.org/spark/spark-4.2.0/spark-4.2.0-bin-hadoop3.tgz
  ```
* <i class='bi bi-4-circle'></i> Extract using:
  
  ``` {.bash}
  tar -xzvf spark-4.2.0-bin-hadoop3.tgz
  ```

## In-Class Demo 2: Your First Spark *Cluster*! {.smaller .text-60 .title-11 .crunch-ul .crunch-li-5}

*Spark Cluster Checklist:*

<i class='bi bi-1-circle' style='font-size: 90%;'></i> **AWS Console** &rarr; **EC2 Console** &rarr; Security group (`launch-wizard-1`):

* [ ] Edit inbound rules &rarr; Add rule &rarr; Type="All traffic" &rarr; Source=itself (`sg`... autocomplete)

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

<i class='bi bi-2-circle' style='font-size: 90%;'></i> **Master node:**

* [x] Created
* [ ] JDK 21 installed: `sudo apt install openjdk-21-jdk-headless`
* [ ] Spark 4.2.0 downloaded, extracted
* [ ] **Private** IP recorded:
  ``` {.bash}
  export PRIVATE_IP=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
  ```
* [ ] `start-master.sh -h <Private IP>`

:::
::: {.column width="50%"}

<i class='bi bi-3-circle' style='font-size: 90%;'></i> **Worker nodes (one at a time):**

* [ ] Created with **existing security group** `launch-wizard-1`
* [ ] `sudo apt update`
* [ ] JDK 21 installed: `sudo apt install openjdk-21-jdk-headless`
* [ ] Spark 4.2.0 downloaded, extracted
* [ ] `start-worker.sh <Private IP>:7077`

:::
::::

<i class='bi bi-4-circle' style='font-size: 90%;'></i> Check status via **Spark UI**: Master on `localhost:8080` (VSCode port forwarding)<br><i class='bi bi-arrow-return-right' style='margin-left: 8px;'></i> *(New worker nodes should appear after each `start-worker.sh`)*

## Now *Use It* From a Jupyter Notebook {.title-09 .crunch-p}

``` {.python}
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
spark = (
  SparkSession
    .builder
    .appName('UNSC_Speeches')
    .master('spark://<Private IP Here!>:7077')
    .config('spark.jars.packages','org.apache.hadoop:hadoop-aws:3.5.0')
    .getOrCreate()
)
```

::: {style="font-size: 80%"}

Check status of **`SparkSession`** via **Spark Session UI**: `localhost:4040`

* Master node UI: `localhost:8080` (worker UI=`localhost:8081`)
* `SparkSession` UI: `localhost:4040`
* Confusion &darr;, Understanding &uarr; 🥳

:::

## Spark NLP {.smaller .crunch-title data-name="Spark NLP"}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

**MLlib**: `pyspark` as normal:

``` {.python}
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
spark = (
    SparkSession
    .builder
    .appName('SF_Housing')
    .getOrCreate()
)
type(spark)
# >>> pyspark.sql.session.SparkSession
from pyspark.ml.feature import VectorAssembler
```

**Spark NLP**: *Custom* `SparkSession` with `sparknlp.start()`:

``` {.python}
import sparknlp
spark = sparknlp.start()
type(spark)
# >>> pyspark.sql.session.SparkSession
from sparknlp.base import DocumentAssembler
```

:::
